story: Explore the fascinating world of the White Tailed Sea Eagle (Turdus albocinctus). Classified under the Turdidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits High mountain coniferous/rhododendron forest; alpine meadows; and open forests. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the White Tailed Sea Eagle is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the White Tailed Sea Eagle, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
